submission.comment: Best strategy found: long-only MA crossover with fast=2, slow=120, and volatility targeting. Achieves 1.401 annualized Sharpe ratio with 68.5% annual return, 48.9% annual volatility, 38% max drawdown, and low turnover (3.6% daily). Tested 243 total strategy combinations across momentum, MA crossover, mean reversion, breakout, and RSI families.
